title: sites.brief-snapshot.candidate.v0.1
description: Proposed private immutable Onepage briefing snapshot. Every identity and sourceState is a selector or declaration, never authentication or proof of payment, material approval, client acceptance or permission to generate/publish.
$comment: Schema validation alone cannot verify private access, duplicate JSON keys, exact byte digests/sizes, source authority, source-version history, CAS, idempotency, unique material payloadRef values or total material bytes. The candidate semantic rules require briefRevision = expectedBriefRevision + 1, unique material payloadRef values and at most 52428800 material bytes. sourceVersion is the legacy aggregate order version; it is not briefRevision. The private JSON body follows onepage-brief-payload.schema.json plus its documented UTF-16 and submission semantics. No byte normalization or JSON re-encoding is allowed when checking a referenced SHA-256.

reference.description: Opaque selector. It is not a URL, path, credential or permission to resolve a private object.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact referenced bytes, including any whitespace or final LF. Not a semantic JSON digest.

sizeBytes.description: Proposed technical byte ceiling compatible with the existing protected file reader. Distinct from legacy HTTP body limits and per-field UTF-16 limits.

sourceVersion.description: Reported aggregate legacy version, including save/submit/review/upload/delete changes. Not an immutable content revision.

sourceState.description: Reported source state only. Validation does not verify the approver, source freshness or permission to consume the payload/materials.
